newsitem.title: USA: U.S. refinery copper stocks up in March - ABMS. [CORRECTED 13:03 GMT]
newsitem.headline: U.S. refinery copper stocks up in March - ABMS. [CORRECTED 13:03 GMT]

text.p: Refined copper stocks held by U.S. refineries rose to 18,300 short tons at the end of March from 14,200 short tons in February, said American Bureau of Metal Statistics.
Commodity Exchange Inc copper stocks were 43,600 short tons in the month, up from 24,800 short tons in February.
London Metal Exchange copper stocks in the U.S. totaled 54,100 short tons in March, down from 65,400 short tons the previous month.
Combined refinery, Comex, and London Metal Exchange stocks rose to 116,000 short tons in March from 104,400 short tons in February.
U.S. refined production rose to 216,700 (corrects figure from 1,171,000) short tons from a February tally of 200,700 (corrects figure from 1,119,900).
